tools.name: start_website
tools.description: Creates a new, empty website and returns its websiteId, the editKey for changing it, the viewUrl where it can be seen, the keepUrl where the person keeps it, and the rules and size limits its files must meet. Each call makes a separate website; to change one already started, save to its websiteId in

tools.name: save_website_files
tools.description: Adds or replaces files on a website and checks every page against the rules start_website returned. Files not sent stay as they are; delete_website_file removes one. Returns the viewUrl, keepUrl, pages, passed, and problems naming each rule a page breaks; the person can keep the website once passed

tools.name: list_website_files
tools.description: Lists every file saved on a website, with each path and its size in bytes, beside the viewUrl, keepUrl, pages, passed and any problems. It changes nothing. The paths are the ones read_website_file and delete_website_file take.

tools.name: read_website_file
tools.description: Returns one saved file from a website with its path, encoding and content: pages, stylesheets and scripts as utf8 text, pictures and fonts as base64. It changes nothing. A path that is not saved fails with no_such_file; list_website_files shows which paths exist.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Asks a domain registrar, live, which names can be registered, and returns up to about a dozen, each with its name, whether it is available and whether it is premium. Availability can change at any moment. Nothing is bought or held; a name is bought from the website's keep page.

tools.name: delete_website
tools.description: Permanently deletes a whole website: every file, its address and its keep link. It cannot be undone. To remove one file instead, use delete_website_file. A website with a plan is refused with has_a_plan; the person removes it from their dashboard.

tools.name: delete_website_file
tools.description: Removes one saved file from a website, then checks the remaining pages against the rules start_website returned, and returns the same report as save_website_files. tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the websites in the person's Jaybird Digital account, sorted by name, with each one's id, name and live address.
